content.text: {"turns":[{"speaker":"baker","line":"Aldric! Fancy meeting you here, and you never at market before noon.","emotion":"amused","gesture":"lean_in"},{"speaker":"smith","line":"Don't. Six silver, Maud. You said harvest's end. Harvest ended.","emotion":"weary","gesture":"none"},{"speaker":"baker","line":"And you'll have it, every coin — soon as I learn what the miller's daughter was doing at your forge past dark.","emotion":"conspiratorial","gesture":"lean_in"},{"speaker":"smith","line":"She brought a broken hinge. That's the whole of it. Six silver by Sunday, or I take the oven door off its pins myself.","emotion":"angry","gesture":"point"}]}
